name: Signal hardware
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished HORIZONTAL 16:10 desktop website HERO ONLY for Pingora. This is concept 01: Signal hardware, LIGHT THEME. A tactile industrial design study. Centered short giant headline above a sculptural brushed-aluminum connection hub, real physical toggle, single recessed green status lamp. Premium warm-gray/graphite hardware with sage accents. The product visual is two thin device planes linked by a subtle signal line, not a literal router. Refined grotesk type, technical micro labels, generous margins.
One page frame, no browser chrome, no collage, no multiple sections. Extremely high-end art direction and crisp readable website typography. Show top navigation: Pingora, Features, Docs, GitHub, theme toggle. Exact headline: "Your phone. Your desktop. In sync." Small subheading: "Notifications, clipboard and sharing. Android meets Linux." CTA: "Explore Pingora", secondary "Read the docs". Small "In development" label; do not claim a released download, users or metrics. Primary visual is illustrative local device sync, no charts or generic analytics dashboards. Three lines maximum main heading. Big comfortable spacing. Light-theme material colors intentionally light, dark legible ink. Tasteful tactile button inspired by real physical face/base construction, subtle controlled shadows, no card nesting. No watermark. Render a single finished website hero as a beautiful design image, not as a photo of a screen.
